attributes.name: Druva - Privileged Action Immediately After Login
attributes.description: Detects an administrator login followed closely by privileged Druva administrative activity from the same administrator. This sequence can indicate rapid post-authentication abuse of a compromised account.
author: Druva

meta.customer_usecase: Detects an administrator login followed closely by privileged Druva administrative activity from the same administrator. This sequence can indicate rapid post-authentication abuse of a compromised account.

attributes.query:
FROM logs-druva.event-*
| WHERE druva.feature == "Admin Event"
| EVAL event_time = @timestamp
| EVAL actor = COALESCE(
    TO_STRING(user.id),
    TO_STRING(user.name),
    TO_STRING(user.email)
  )
| EVAL is_login = druva.event_type == "Admin Login"
| EVAL is_privileged_action = druva.event_type != "Admin Login"
| WHERE actor IS NOT NULL AND (is_login OR is_privileged_action)
| STATS
    login_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_login,
    privileged_action_count = COUNT(*) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    login_time = MAX(event_time) WHERE is_login,
    first_privileged_action = MIN(event_time) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    actions = VALUES(druva.event_type) WHERE is_privileged_action,
    login_ips = VALUES(TO_STRING(source.ip)) WHERE is_login
  BY actor
| WHERE login_count > 0
    AND privileged_action_count > 0
    AND first_privileged_action >= login_time
| EVAL minutes_to_action = DATE_DIFF("minutes", login_time, first_privileged_action)
| WHERE minutes_to_action <= 5
